title: Cost views: screen-reader friendly charts + locale-aware number/date formatting
creator: Maya Patel
description:
Problem: The cost breakdown widgets (token-based charts, per-route cost bars, and invoice preview) render rich visual information but are not reliably accessible across screen readers, and numeric/date formatting does not respect user locale preferences. This causes misunderstandings for international customers and fails WCAG 2.1 AA expectations for non-text content and programmatic access.

Goal: Produce a design + prototype deliverable that: (1) defines ARIA semantics and a textual synopsis pattern for all chart widgets; (2) maps keyboard focus order for interactive chart elements and drilldowns; (3) documents locale-aware formatting rules (numbers, currencies, percentages, date ranges) and RTL layout mirroring; and (4) provides contrast token swaps for high-contrast and color-blind safe palettes. Deliverables should be concrete enough for eng to implement and for QA to test with VoiceOver/NVDA/JAWS and with multiple locales (en-US, fr-FR, ja-JP, ar-SA).
acceptance_criteria: All cost chart widgets expose an aria-labelledby + aria-describedby pattern with a concise textual summary for screen readers
Interactive slices/bars are keyboard focusable and expose role=button with aria-pressed/aria-expanded where appropriate
Number and currency formatting uses ICU/CLDR rules (sample mapping included) and a user preference fallback in console settings
RTL layouts mirror axis labels, tick ordering and focus order for charts without breaking data semantics
Color tokens provided for default, high-contrast and deuteranopia-safe palettes with WCAG 2.1 AA contrast >=4.5:1 for text and >=3:1 for large graphical elements
Prototype in Figma + a lightweight HTML proof-of-concept with aria attributes exists and is linked
QA checklist created with explicit NVDA/VoiceOver test cases and locale fixtures
tasks: Audit: inventory all cost-view chart instances and data export points in Console
Design: craft accessible chart pattern (visuals + textual synopsis) and keyboard focus flow diagrams
I18n: create mapping table for number/currency/date formats and a toggle spec for user locale preference
Prototype: build Figma screens and a small HTML demo demonstrating aria live regions and keyboard nav
Contrast: propose alternate color tokens and validate with automated contrast tools and manual checks
Handoff: annotate Figma with detailed aria/data attributes and create implementation notes for ENG
Usability Testing: run 4 moderated sessions (screen-reader users) and compile findings
Docs: update Console accessibility guide with examples and QA test script
comments: 2026-03-02: Kickoff meeting with product & eng. Agreed scope is limited to cost widgets on Billing and Route analytics pages for v2026.04.
2026-03-04: First draft of audible synopsis pattern posted to Drive. PM asked to prefer short numeric summaries for busy screens.
2026-03-06: Eng (ENG-4812) flagged potential perf impact for live region updates on high-throughput charts; we agreed to debounce announcements and provide user setting to toggle verbose narration.

2026-03-08: Design review with accessibility consultant (external). Recommendation: add a ‘compact summary’ ARIA role for keyboard users and provide a CSV download fallback for screen reader users who prefer raw data.
2026-03-10: Implementer notes added to Figma: include aria-roledescription='cost segment' and aria-labels that include localized currency symbols and pluralization where needed.

2026-03-12: Prototype HTML created and tested on macOS VoiceOver (en-US) and NVDA (Windows, fr-FR locale). Found an issue: percent labels truncated in RTL when axis tick order mirrored — created follow-up task to update tick spacing.
2026-03-13: PM approved the acceptance criteria; moving to In Progress for engineering implementation. Usability testing sessions scheduled for 2026-03-22 to 2026-03-26.
